hints.title: Two-Resource Knapsack
hints.text: For each fruit, we have three choices: do not buy, buy at full price price[i] using 0 coupons, or buy at half price price[i] // 2 using 1 coupon.

hints.title: Multi-Dimensional State Table
hints.text: Maintain dp[amount][coupons] representing the maximum tastiness achievable with a given money budget and coupon budget.

hints.title: Reverse Iteration for 0-1 Knapsack
hints.text: Iterate backwards over money from maxAmount down to 0, and over coupons from maxCoupons down to 0 to prevent reusing the same fruit.

hints.title: Dual Budget Knapsack Implementation

complexity.notes: 2D table iterated in reverse for each item in the knapsack.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive 3-way branching on each fruit takes O(3^n) exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(maxAmount * maxCoupons) space suffices by overwriting state in-place.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models 3-choice knapsack with 2D dynamic programming and backward iteration.
